title: Found a camp
description: Mark a camp near a discovered dungeon. Settlers gather and deliver its 12 wood.

title: Build a workbench
description: An open bench where residents craft wooden and stone tools and weapons, one at a time. It takes 4 wood.

title: Craft a wooden axe
description: A wooden axe fells trees faster than bare hands. Craft one at the workbench from 3 wood.

title: Craft wooden tools
description: A pick, mallet or hoe makes mining, building or farming faster; a shovel tills and lays roads faster still. Craft two at the workbench.

title: Craft a first weapon
description: A wooden sword, club, spear or short bow hits harder than fists. Craft one at the bench.

title: Equip both founders
description: Crafted gear goes straight into a free hand. Give each founder a tool or a weapon of their own.

title: Build a tent
description: Shelter the founders and make room for the newcomers to come.

title: Build a farmhouse
description: Prepare a food supply for the settlement.

title: Plant a field
description: Draw a field near the farmhouse.

title: Build an altar
description: Odin's altar needs 4 stone: builders break grey rock by hand. No rock in sight? Explore for it.

title: Reach 4 residents
description: Pray at Odin's altar with 4 food and a free bed: a new resident joins when the prayer ends.

title: Lay a road
description: Draw and complete a road connected to the camp.

title: Build a lumberyard
description: Needs a road. Establish a timber supply near trees; its workers fell faster with axes in hand.

title: Build a well
description: Give your residents drinking water.

title: Build a quarry
description: Needs a road. Establish a supply of stone.

title: Build a storehouse
description: Increase room for delivered resources.

title: Build a sawmill
description: Assign a worker to turn two logs into one plank for advanced construction.

title: Build stoneworks
description: Dress two rough stones into one cut stone for advanced construction.

title: Build a hostel
description: Earn lodging income from temporary visitors. Guests never become residents.

title: Build a tavern
description: Give residents somewhere to relax.

title: Reach 6 residents
description: Expand housing and supplies for growth.

title: Build a market
description: Let trade support the settlement.

title: Build a guild
description: Needs a quarry and 6 residents. Choose a resident to take a one-time professional oath at the guild.

title: Swear a fighter
description: Select the guild and choose a settler to swear a calling. Each calling has one ability: press Q to use it.

title: Build a training yard
description: Needs a guild. Two residents drill there each day and gain experience, though fighting still teaches faster.

title: Beat off a raid
description: Raids are warned during the day. Gather your fighters by the camp and kill every raider that comes.

title: Build a watchtower
description: Needs a training yard and a raid beaten off. A resident keeps watch and shoots raiders who come near.

title: Reach 10 residents
description: Support a larger working population.

title: Build a weaponsmith
description: Needs a guild and 10 residents. Forges iron tools and weapons, far better than wooden ones.

title: Forge a weapon
description: Craft an iron weapon at the weaponsmith from a resident's equipment. Camp-made weapons do not count.

title: Reach 12 residents
description: Expand the settlement.

title: Build an armorer
description: Needs a floor cleared beyond a gate. Mail and shields keep your fighters on their feet.

title: Build an apothecary
description: Needs the altar of Odin and 6 residents. Its healer treats the hurt and closes lasting wounds sooner.

title: Build a chapel
description: Needs an altar and 10 residents. Gives residents a place to pray.

title: Reach 16 residents
description: Keep a growing town supplied.

title: Build a mage tower
description: Needs an apothecary. Develops a source of mana.

title: Lead a party of three
description: Click a discovered gate, choose three residents in the expedition window and set out.

title: Slay a floor guardian
description: Fight through to the heart of a floor and kill its guardian. When it winds up a slam, move your party off the marked ground.

title: Revive a downed ally
description: A resident at 0 health is downed, not dead. Select an ally and right-click the fallen one to revive them before they bleed out.

title: Raise a runestone
description: Carve the names of the fallen in stone. While it stands, the settlement grieves less.

title: Seal a gate
description: Kill the guardian of the third floor beyond one gate. A sealed gate never raids again and pays a great hoard.

title: Reach 30 residents
description: Maintain homes, food and water for everyone.

title: Build a portal
description: Needs a mage tower, a guild and a sealed gate. Draws more visitors, and for 8 mana pulls a party home from beyond a gate, even mid-fight.

title: Seal every gate
description: Close every gate to the other worlds to make Midgard safe.
